en: Color postcard showing a rural scene with traditional wooden buildings and farm structures on a grassy field. On the left stands a tall, slender wooden church tower with a steep shingled spire and small belfry openings below the roof, typical of Eastern European wooden churches. In the foreground and middle ground are several simple timber sheds with high-pitched plank roofs sheltering farming equipment or machinery. To the right is a larger two‑story wooden house or barn with a balcony. Low, hazy hills form the background under a pale blue sky. There is no visible printed caption or other text on the image side.
